editorial:
Imagine having the worst day of your life, and then it just keeps getting worse. You follow a crooked cop who accidentally hits a man with his car. Instead of calling for help, he panics and hides the body in a coffin at his mother-in-law's funeral. It sounds crazy, but the movie turns this messy situation into a wild ride. You will feel the pressure building up as he tries to act normal while a mysterious stranger starts blackmailing him. The vibe is a mix of a tense crime thriller and a dark comedy that makes you laugh at how bad things are getting for the main character.

The pacing is incredibly fast, and you will be on the edge of your seat wondering how he can possibly dig himself out of this hole. The acting is top-notch, especially the way the lead actor shows pure panic. While some of the plot twists might feel a bit too lucky, the excitement makes up for it. If you love movies that keep you guessing, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The mystery man is actually the father of the man the cop killed. He wanted revenge for his son's death. In the final showdown, the cop manages to kill the witness in a struggle. To cover his tracks, he frames the dead man as a criminal. He manages to get away with the crime and stays out of jail, but he is left broken and exhausted by the trauma of his choices.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves high-stakes thrillers with a dark sense of humor.
